categories.main_business_segments: The company's primary business segments include adsorption and separation materials (ion exchange resins, adsorption resins, chelating resins, uniform particle resins, solid-phase synthesis carriers, chromatography fillers, and chromatography media) and system integration devices. The company operates across six major application domains: metal resources, life sciences, water treatment and ultrapure water, food processing, energy conservation and environmental protection, and chemical engineering and catalysis.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include spray granulation technology for uniform particle resin synthesis, functionalization techniques for various polymer bases (polystyrene, polyacrylate, polymethacrylate), chelation technology for metal ion separation, and system integration design. Manufacturing methods involve polymerization, crosslinking, functionalization, and continuous adsorption processes. The company has developed proprietary technologies for salt lake lithium extraction, rare earth metal separation, and biopharmaceutical purification.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include metal resource extraction companies (lithium, cobalt, nickel, gallium producers), biopharmaceutical manufacturers (vaccine, antibody, recombinant protein producers), water treatment facilities, food processing companies (juice concentration), chemical manufacturers (chlor-alkali, hydrogen peroxide production), and semiconductor/electronics manufacturers. End markets span metal resources, life sciences, water treatment, food processing, environmental protection, and chemical catalysis sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major production facilities in Xi'an (headquarters and main manufacturing), Gaoping, Puyang, and Hebi. International operations include subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Belgium (Ionex Engineering BVBA), Germany (Sunresin New Materials GmbH), Ireland (PuriTech Ltd.), and Argentina (Sunresin SA). The company serves customers across North America, Europe, Asia, South America, and Africa.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures specialized functional polymer materials (adsorption and separation resins) and integrates these materials into system solutions for end-users. The company also provides application technology development and system integration services, positioning itself as both a materials supplier and technology solutions provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing salt lake lithium extraction technology, developing high-performance materials for semiconductor and nuclear applications, expanding biopharmaceutical separation solutions (particularly for GLP-1 drugs and mRNA purification), advancing CO2 capture technology for carbon neutrality goals, and developing VOCs treatment solutions. R&D focuses on material synthesis innovation, application process optimization, and system integration capabilities across emerging application domains.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through three primary channels: (1) direct sales of adsorption and separation materials to industrial customers, (2) sales of system integration devices and equipment, and (3) technical service fees. Revenue is recognized upon customer acceptance of products (for materials and equipment) or upon installation and commissioning (for system devices). The company employs a technical marketing model with integrated sales, application support, and after-sales service.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as the leading domestic manufacturer of adsorption and separation materials in China and a recognized international competitor. Major international competitors include Dow Chemical, Purolite, and other multinational chemical companies. The company differentiates through comprehensive product portfolio, advanced spray granulation technology, integrated system solutions, and strong R&D capabilities. It holds significant market share in emerging application domains like lithium extraction and biopharmaceutical purification.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-to-large scale manufacturer with 2023 revenue of approximately 2.49 billion yuan, representing 29.6% growth from 2022 (1.92 billion yuan). Net profit attributable to shareholders was 717 million yuan in 2023, up 33.4% year-over-year. Total assets reached 5.7 billion yuan at year-end 2023. The company demonstrates strong growth trajectory with consistent double-digit revenue and profit expansion over recent years, supported by capacity expansion and market share gains.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's value proposition centers on providing integrated adsorption and separation solutions combining high-performance materials, proprietary application technologies, and customized system integration. Key differentiators include: advanced spray granulation technology for uniform particle resins (breaking international monopolies), comprehensive product portfolio spanning multiple application domains, proven expertise in emerging fields like lithium extraction and biopharmaceutical purification, strong technical service capabilities, and commitment to material-process-equipment integration for superior customer outcomes.
